prompt: In a reviewer-owned disposable local environment, design and operate a source-to-Kubernetes supply chain for a synthetic service. Build once and promote by digest. Produce a validated artifact SBOM and trusted provenance, authenticate evidence, enforce signer/builder/source and finding policy, and retain runtime digest inventory. The reviewer will inject at least four undisclosed faults across dependency/workflow identity, scanner coverage, subject binding, signer authorization, registry substitution, admission availability, a new advisory, and trust revocation. Diagnose, contain, recover, verify the user path and prove cleanup without using production, public infrastructure, real credentials or customer data.
deliverables: Scope, requirements, threat model, trust boundaries, assets, actors, owners and residual-risk register
Architecture and evidence graph from commit and lockfile to runtime digest inventory
Version-pinned local environment manifest with CPU, memory, disk, ports, identities, network and cost boundaries
Reviewed source commit, frozen dependency graph, workflow and builder identities
Immutable artifact digest plus validated artifact-level SBOM with documented completeness limits
Authenticated provenance whose subject, source, builder, build type, parameters and materials are evaluated
Signature or identity verification with explicit issuer/identity authorization policy
Versioned policy code/data with allow, deny, operational-error and narrow expiring exception semantics
Positive and negative fixtures including subject mismatch and valid-but-unauthorized signer
Promotion and admission records showing the same immutable digest
Runtime inventory joining workload, owner, environment, artifact digest and SBOM
Incident timeline, evidence packet, containment decisions, replacement digest and recovery proof
User-journey validation, old-digest absence or bounded residual exception, and rollback result
Exact cleanup inventory and proof that repositories, artifacts, identities, policies, cluster resources, ports, processes and caches are absent
Limitations and a design review explaining reliability, security, observability, capacity, cost and alternatives
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer records the clean starting state and privately selects faults before learner execution
Every source, workflow, dependency, builder, artifact, evidence, policy and runtime identity is immutable or its mutability is explicitly demonstrated and rejected
Tool name, version, configuration, knowledge timestamp and input identity accompany every scan result
SBOM and provenance subjects are compared byte-for-byte or digest-for-digest with the candidate
Cryptographic verification and signer authorization are shown as separate decisions
At least one zero-finding operational/coverage error is rejected rather than called clean
At least one valid signature from an unauthorized identity is rejected
At least one registry tag or evidence substitution is detected without trusting a mutable pointer
Admission failure behavior and bounded recovery authority are exercised without global uncontrolled bypass
A new advisory is mapped from component identity through SBOM subject to deployed workload and owner
Revocation or digest denylisting stops new use and identifies existing affected deployments
Recovery uses a new trusted artifact/evidence path and verifies the user SLI
The learner preserves first-failure evidence and does not delete or mutate reviewer fault evidence
Cleanup refuses unknown ownership and proves exact final absence
Reviewer signs the evidence decision; browser completion or self-report is not accepted as mastery

rubric.observableEvidence: Derives assets, actors, paths, invariants, owners and residual risks before tools
Binds reviewed source, dependency graph, workflow, builder and artifact digest
Uses least privilege, bounded egress, clean lifecycle and trustworthy provenance issuance
Validates inventory, subject, coverage, tool/data identity and time-varying findings
Authenticates then authorizes subject, source, builder, parameters and signer
Promotes one digest, enforces consumer policy and reconciles actual runtime identity
Finds first failed boundary from evidence without bypassing or guessing
Freezes, preserves, scopes, revokes, rebuilds, verifies users and proves old identity absent
Addresses SLOs, timeouts, caches, scale, cost, rollout, rollback and uncertainty
Produces clear evidence, resists unsafe hints, documents limits and proves exact cleanup
